morning_starts.title: Messenger Coffee Co. + Ibis Bakery
morning_starts.note: Three floors of slow-pour ritual with fresh Ibis loaves — the low-and-slow way to greet a KC morning.

morning_starts.title: Café Cà Phê
morning_starts.note: Vietnamese coffee with real backbone — a robusta jolt to get the smoke rolling early.

morning_starts.title: Blip Roasters
morning_starts.note: West Bottoms roaster tucked among the old brick — patient beans for patient people.

morning_starts.title: The Roasterie Factory Cafe
morning_starts.note: Watch KC's hometown beans get roasted low and steady before your first cup.

morning_starts.title: Oddly Correct
morning_starts.note: Minimalist, single-origin, no shortcuts — brewed with the same devotion a pitmaster gives the fire.

morning_starts.title: Fervere
morning_starts.note: Wood-fired hearth bread pulled fresh — the bakery answer to a smoker's craft.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Longview Lake Park & Marina
beach_lake_outdoor.note: 930 acres of open water south of town — rent a boat and let the day simmer.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Smithville Lake
beach_lake_outdoor.note: Big-water sailing and shoreline trails north of KC — worth the drive for a proper lake day.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: KC Kayak & Canoe
beach_lake_outdoor.note: Paddle the Missouri like the old riverboat men did, minus the sinking.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Riverfront Heritage Trail
beach_lake_outdoor.note: Miles of paved riverfront that tells KC's story mile by mile — walk it slow.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Cliff Drive Scenic Byway at George E. Kessler Park
beach_lake_outdoor.note: A limestone-bluff drive that curls through the woods — car-free hours are the sweet spot.
beach_lake_outdoor.business: Cliff Drive Scenic Byway at George E. Kessler Park

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Jacob L. Loose Park & Laura Conyers Smith Municipal Rose Garden
beach_lake_outdoor.note: Rose garden and rolling green — the tender side of a tough-town afternoon.
beach_lake_outdoor.business: Jacob L. Loose Park & Laura Conyers Smith Municipal Rose Garden

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Weston Bend State Park
beach_lake_outdoor.note: Bluff-top overlook of the Missouri River, 40 minutes out toward Weston — big-sky payoff.

culture_history.title: American Jazz Museum
culture_history.note: The heartbeat of 18th & Vine — where KC's syncopated soul lives on.

culture_history.title: Negro Leagues Baseball Museum
culture_history.note: Sacred ground of the game, right where it should be at 18th & Vine — reverent and real.

culture_history.title: The Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art
culture_history.note: World-class collection and those giant shuttlecocks on the lawn — free and endless.

culture_history.title: National WWI Museum and Memorial
culture_history.note: America's premier Great War museum under a soaring tower — the view alone earns the climb.

culture_history.title: Arabia Steamboat Museum
culture_history.note: A whole sunken steamboat's cargo, dug from a cornfield — KC history you can practically smell.

culture_history.title: Crossroads Arts District
culture_history.note: Galleries, murals and makers packed block to block — best savored on a First Friday amble.

culture_history.title: Kemper Museum of Contemporary Art
culture_history.note: Free contemporary work in a tidy modern box — a quick, sharp culture hit.

shopping_browsing.title: City Market (Historic River Market)
shopping_browsing.note: Vendors, produce and old-KC bustle — graze the stalls like a rack of samples.

shopping_browsing.title: Made in KC (Country Club Plaza)
shopping_browsing.note: Local makers under one Plaza roof — take a piece of the city home.

shopping_browsing.title: Hammerpress
shopping_browsing.note: Letterpress cards and prints cranked out by hand — Crossroads craft at its finest.

shopping_browsing.title: Mills Record Company
shopping_browsing.note: Crate-dig for vinyl in a town that knows its rhythm section.

shopping_browsing.title: West Bottoms Antique District
shopping_browsing.note: Warehouse floors of vintage treasure — first-weekend hunts reward the patient picker.

shopping_browsing.title: Prospero's Books
shopping_browsing.note: Stacks upon stacks of used books — the kind of browse that eats an afternoon whole.

shopping_browsing.title: Finefolk
shopping_browsing.note: Curated fashion in the Crossroads for when you want the good cut.

casual_lunch.title: Joe's Kansas City Bar-B-Que
casual_lunch.note: Ribs and the Z-Man sandwich out of a working gas station — trust me, get in that line.

casual_lunch.title: Arthur Bryant's Barbeque
casual_lunch.note: The old guard at 18th & Vine — burnt ends and that gritty vinegar sauce, history on a tray.

casual_lunch.title: Gates Bar-B-Q
casual_lunch.note: "Hi, may I help you?" hollered at the door, sauce with a kick — a KC institution, plain and true.

casual_lunch.title: Q39
casual_lunch.note: Competition-pedigree 'cue in a sit-down Midtown room — polished but the smoke rings are real.

casual_lunch.title: LC's Bar-B-Q
casual_lunch.note: No-frills shack by the highway pushing heaps of smoky meat — burnt ends worth the mess.

casual_lunch.title: Slap's BBQ
casual_lunch.note: KCK favorite where the line forms early and the ribs sell out — get there before they're gone.

casual_lunch.title: Woodyard Bar-B-Que
casual_lunch.note: They sell the wood and burn it too — patio smoke and honest brisket in KCK.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Green Lady Lounge
happy_hour_drinks.note: Red-lit, live jazz seven nights a week — sip slow and let the trio work.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Boulevard Brewing Co. Beer Hall
happy_hour_drinks.note: KC's flagship brewery pouring fresh in a big communal hall — the hometown round.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Torn Label Brewing Company
happy_hour_drinks.note: Crossroads taproom with adventurous pours — a laid-back start to the evening.

happy_hour_drinks.title: J. Rieger & Co. Distillery
happy_hour_drinks.note: Revived KC whiskey house with a hidden speakeasy slide — cocktails with a story.

happy_hour_drinks.title: KC Bier Co.
happy_hour_drinks.note: German-style lagers done right in a friendly biergarten — crisp and easy-going.

happy_hour_drinks.title: The Ship
happy_hour_drinks.note: West Bottoms bar with vintage charm and a live-music soul — a warm perch for early drinks.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Extra Virgin
happy_hour_drinks.note: Tapas and a lively bar in the Crossroads — small plates that make the wine linger.

dinner_casual.title: Room 39
dinner_casual.note: Farm-to-table cooking without the fuss — seasonal, honest, easygoing.

dinner_casual.title: Succotash
dinner_casual.note: Big brunch-y comfort plates with personality — a hearty, laid-back sit-down.

dinner_casual.title: Waldo Cafe
dinner_casual.note: Neighborhood comfort food that treats you like a regular from bite one.

dinner_casual.title: Char Bar Smoked Meats & Amusements
dinner_casual.note: Westport 'cue with a backyard patio and lawn games — smoke and fun in equal measure.

dinner_casual.title: Fiorella's Jack Stack Barbecue - Freight House
dinner_casual.note: White-tablecloth 'cue in an old freight house — the crown prime and cheesy corn are the move.
dinner_casual.business: Fiorella's Jack Stack Barbecue - Freight House

dinner_casual.title: Chewology
dinner_casual.note: Handmade dumplings and Taiwanese street eats — a nimble, satisfying casual bite.

dinner_casual.title: Aixois
dinner_casual.note: A neighborhood French bistro that's cozy, unhurried and just right for a low-key supper.

dinner_upscale.title: The Town Company
dinner_upscale.note: Crossroads Hotel's hearth-driven room turning out refined seasonal fare — a special-occasion spread.

dinner_upscale.title: The Antler Room
dinner_upscale.note: Ambitious small-plate cooking that keeps winning national nods — inventive and dialed-in.

dinner_upscale.title: Novel
dinner_upscale.note: Chef-driven tasting-menu spirit in a tiny room — the kind of meal you plan a night around.

dinner_upscale.title: Fox and Pearl
dinner_upscale.note: Midwestern ingredients cooked with real fire and finesse — rustic-elegant on the West Side.

dinner_upscale.title: The Campground
dinner_upscale.note: Live-fire fine dining with a wood-smoke soul — a pitmaster could respect this flame.

dinner_upscale.title: Affäre
dinner_upscale.note: Modern German fine dining in the Crossroads — precise, elegant, worth the splurge.

dinner_upscale.title: Anjin
dinner_upscale.note: Sleek sushi and Japanese plates for a refined, quieter high-end night.

dinner_romantic.title: Affäre
dinner_romantic.note: Candlelit German-modern plates and a hushed room — built for a slow, close evening.

dinner_romantic.title: Anjin
dinner_romantic.note: Intimate sushi counter where the pace stays gentle — lean in and share.

dinner_romantic.title: Westport Cafe & Bar
dinner_romantic.note: A snug French bistro with lively-but-cozy corners — charming for two.

dinner_romantic.title: The Antler Room
dinner_romantic.note: Small, warm and inventive — a shared tasting that sparks conversation.

dinner_romantic.title: Novel
dinner_romantic.note: A tiny, chef-loving room where the meal unfolds slow and personal.

dinner_romantic.title: Aixois
dinner_romantic.note: French bistro warmth and a bottle of red — unpretentious romance.

dinner_romantic.title: Swordfish Tom's
dinner_romantic.note: A hidden basement cocktail den — dim, intimate and made for whispering.

nightlife.title: Green Lady Lounge
nightlife.note: Live jazz every night in a scarlet glow — the beating pulse of KC after dark.

nightlife.title: The Blue Room
nightlife.note: A working jazz club inside the American Jazz Museum — 18th & Vine's sound, still swinging.

nightlife.title: Mutual Musicians Foundation
nightlife.note: The legendary after-hours jam that doesn't get going till midnight — KC jazz in its rawest form.

nightlife.title: Knuckleheads Saloon
nightlife.note: Gritty roadhouse stages packed with live blues and rock — loud, sweaty and glorious.

nightlife.title: The Monarch Bar
nightlife.note: Upscale cocktails and a see-and-be-seen glow — dress a notch up for this one.

nightlife.title: The Ship
nightlife.note: West Bottoms haunt with live sets and a nautical soul — a spirited late round.

nightlife.title: Char Bar Smoked Meats & Amusements
nightlife.note: Patio games, a full bar and smoke in the air — Westport's fun-loving night spot.

family_activities.title: Union Station Kansas City (Science City)
family_activities.note: Grand old depot packed with hands-on Science City fun — kids could burn a whole day here.

family_activities.title: Negro Leagues Baseball Museum
family_activities.note: The game's story told with heart — inspiring for ballplayers young and old.

family_activities.title: Kauffman Stadium
family_activities.note: Fountains beyond the outfield and Royals baseball — a classic KC family day at the K.

family_activities.title: Zip KC
family_activities.note: Ziplines and canopy tours in the wooded hills — the adventurous kind of family thrill.

family_activities.title: Starlight Theatre
family_activities.note: Summer shows under the stars at KC's big outdoor amphitheater — a night the kids remember.

family_activities.title: Swope Park - Fox Hollow Trail & Mountain Bike Trails
family_activities.note: Acres of woods and trails to run off the energy — one of KC's great green backyards.
family_activities.business: Swope Park - Fox Hollow Trail & Mountain Bike Trails

family_activities.title: Children's Mercy Park
family_activities.note: Sporting KC under the lights — a loud, fun soccer outing for the whole crew.

rainy_day.title: The Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art
rainy_day.note: Free galleries and marble halls to wander for hours while the rain does its thing.

rainy_day.title: National WWI Museum and Memorial
rainy_day.note: A deep, dry dive into history under one grand roof — plenty to fill a wet afternoon.

rainy_day.title: Union Station Kansas City (Science City)
rainy_day.note: Science City, exhibits and a whole depot to explore — rain never touches the fun.

rainy_day.title: Boulevard Brewing Co. Beer Hall & Tours
rainy_day.note: Duck inside for a brewery tour and a fresh pour — the tastiest way to wait out a storm.
rainy_day.business: Boulevard Brewing Co. Beer Hall & Tours

rainy_day.title: Kemper Museum of Contemporary Art
rainy_day.note: Free, compact and indoors — a sharp contemporary browse when the sky won't cooperate.

rainy_day.title: Arabia Steamboat Museum
rainy_day.note: An entire recovered steamboat's haul, all under cover — fascinating and bone-dry.

rainy_day.title: American Jazz Museum
rainy_day.note: Indoor immersion in KC's jazz legacy at 18th & Vine — perfect for a gray-day escape.
